summary: Andy Albosta, 46, fell ~50 feet while ice climbing in Cascade Canyon. He suffered a broken pelvis, a collapsed lung, and internal bleeding; SAR paramedics responded rapidly and he was flown immediately to Albuquerque. His recovery was expected to take four months, during which he was out of work from his electrician business.
responding_agency: La Plata County Search and Rescue
notes: Date approximate (weekday-inferred): GoFundMe states the accident was "Saturday, January 20th"; 2024-01-20 was a Saturday (2025-01-20 was a Monday), verified via date -d. Un-parked the run-681 lead (year resolvable by weekday).
